title: cistus × longifolius subsp. grosii
intro: Cistus × longifolius subsp. grosii, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a hybrid plant species within the Cistus genus, known for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, as well as its antimicrobial and antifungal properties, making it a potential treatment for skin and wound infections. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
